Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your business name, service category, location and website.
  2. Explain your service area, licenses when required, the types of jobs you handle and how customers should request an estimate.
  3. Explain estimates, scope changes, scheduling and what a customer should have ready before the first visit.
  4. Track listing interest separately from estimates, signed jobs, closings and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not make unsupported licensing, valuation, savings or outcome claims.
  • Keep customer addresses, insurance details and private documents out of public tools.
  • Paid membership does not change factual information or ordinary directory placement.
